searchText: Will EF use portal codebase for any use? I am missing some announce about this. https://blog.ethereum.org/2025/06/02/announcing-protocol thanks <@425615769280315392> , too much info and I could not see any detailed info about portal, although the changes are clear,it is a shame if it will be throw away, i still see potential for portal tech in some uses I had many ideas crossing my mind that would probably not be accepted like incentivize data storage on portal and use bridge nodes to propagate txs on network (receiving some fee as reward), I am not expert in zk ant other techs but I dont know any best alternative to light wallets I still have expectation that portal survive as communirty driven project, will see I am really sorry to hear that.
